**Orglet 0.3.0** for Windows.

If you run 0.2.4 or later from Setup, this update arrives by itself and is used the next time you start Orglet.

### `orglet` in your terminal

Orglet now comes with a command you can run from any terminal. It talks to the app on your computer, so your keys, chats and files stay where they were.

```
orglet send "summarize this" --to Researcher --file notes.md
```

That sends the message into Researcher's chat, waits, and prints the answer. `orglet read`, `orglet list`, `orglet status` and `orglet open` do what their names say, and `--json` makes the output easy to use in a script. If Orglet is not running, the command starts it.

Turn it on in **Settings → About → Add to PATH**, then open a new terminal. It only changes your own user PATH, and **Remove from PATH** undoes it. The command can send messages and read answers. It cannot grant folders, touch keys or settings, or delete anything. How it works: [cli.md](https://github.com/codepawl/orglet/blob/main/docs/cli.md).

### Emoji in the message box

Type `:sk` and a small menu offers the emoji whose names fit, 💀 first. A full name like `:fire:` turns into 🔥 as soon as you type the closing colon. The menu only opens at the start of a message or after a space, and only when something matches, so `10:30` and links stay as you typed them.

### Signing in to Claude Code, Codex and Cursor Agent

The sign-in command in **Settings → Local harnesses** was broken in PowerShell. It now comes in a form for PowerShell, Command Prompt and Git Bash. Pick your terminal on the command card and Orglet remembers the choice. Each form was run in its real shell before this release.

Renaming or switching a harness account used to take three or four seconds, because every CLI was checked again. It now takes a few milliseconds.

The harness row itself is tidier: one column, the version next to the name, and the command on a card with its copy button.

### Before you install

The installer is still not signed. Windows may say it protected your PC. If you downloaded Setup from this page, choose **More info → Run anyway**.

Orglet is open source under AGPL-3.0. This release ships for Windows only. Release checklist: [windows-release-gates.md](https://github.com/codepawl/orglet/blob/main/docs/windows-release-gates.md).
